newsitem.title: USA: FM Properties agrees to sell Circle C land.
newsitem.headline: FM Properties agrees to sell Circle C land.

text.p: FM Properties Inc said Thursday it has agreed to sell the assets of its Circle C Land Corp for $34 million to an investor group.

Circle C's assets consist primarily of about 1,000 acres of undeveloped commercial and multi-family property within the Circle C Ranch development near Austin, Texas, a statement from FM Properties said.
The company said it sold the residential property at the Circle C Ranch development for $15.8 million to the same investor group in 1995.

FM Properties said it has received a $1 million nonrefundable cash deposit on this transaction. It said the balance of the $34 million is to be paid $30 million in cash and $3 million in a secured note at closing, which is expected prior to March 31, 1997.
FM Properties said no significant gain or loss will be realized on the sale and the cash proceeds will be used by the company to reduce its outstanding debt which currently is about $70 million.
